name: Nikugoku no Hemi ~Sawakami to Shikyuu Mushi no Kairaku ni Ochita Bounty Hunter Anna no Unmei ni Tsuite
original_name: 肉獄のヘミ～触髪と子宮蟲の快楽に堕ちたバウンティハンターレビアンナの運命について
source:
Revianna and Lania, interstellar bounty hunters, were young girls dispatched to a multi-sun planet to investigate a mystery. No sooner had they landed than tentacles kidnapped Lania. However, in her struggle, Lania was suddenly saved by a beautiful girl, "Hemi", who somehow repelled all the licentious tendrils with ease. That too was a mystery, and the start of many perversions...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ068450.html]DLsite English[/url]]
